# Wheelgate Cycle Hire - counter book

The counter writes one row for each day the depot opens and records every
bike that leaves the yard that day. Bikes taken out for more than one day
are counted on the day they left.

turns.prompt: Wheelgate Cycle Hire is closing the September figures for the season report. How many bikes left the yard over September 2026?
